title: The Armistice Cipher
logline: A drifting cluster of wartime proximity mines threatens a civilian gate lane, but the two retired enemy commanders who hold the disarm keys refuse to transmit their half first.

roles.description: A retired squadron commodore from the northern league; proud, crippled by old radiation burns, and fiercely suspicious.
Former gunnery chief for the southern coalition; lives in quiet exile tending a remote orbital hydroponic rig.
Harbor master of the central junction gate; desperate to clear the approaching minefield before civilian freighters arrive.
A dense cluster of magnetic antimatter mines drifting inexorably toward the transit gate threshold.
An armed wartime patrol craft crewed by irreconcilable revanchists determined to keep the war alive.
The central traffic junction station where the gate corridor is monitored.

public_situation: A cluster of dormant wartime area-denial mines has broken anchor in {system} and is drifting into the commercial gate corridor. Traffic is suspended.
private_truth: The armistice treaty encoded the disarm sequence so that neither commander's cryptographic cipher can defuse the mines alone without revealing their wartime command frequency.

beats.public_change: The gate authority issues an all-ships navigation warning as the mine cluster approaches threshold clearance.

missions.reason: The gate warden needs an independent pilot with reinforced shielding to scan the minefield core to confirm the ordnance arming model.
missions.private_fact: She knows the station lacks kinetic batteries heavy enough to detonate the mines safely without shattering the gate framework.

beats.public_change: Civilian traffic halts in neighboring systems as transit insurance underwriters cancel gate policies.

missions.reason: The warden hires the pilot to jump to the northern sanctuary and deliver the minefield telemetry to the retired northern commodore.
missions.private_fact: The commodore has refused twelve previous military hails and will only receive couriers flying unflagged civilian ships.

missions.reason: The northern commodore entrusts the pilot with an encrypted hardware key, demanding it only be unlocked if the southern veteran provides proof of life.
missions.private_fact: He fears that transmitting his half of the cipher will expose his real coordinates to prosecution tribunals.

beats.public_change: Revanchist radio broadcasts denounce the armistice and vow to destroy any ship attempting to clear the minefield.

missions.reason: The pilot must travel to an outer farm rig in the southern system to collect the second matching cipher module from the southern veteran.
missions.private_fact: The southern veteran believes the northern commodore died ten years ago and thinks this mission is a police sting.

missions.reason: The southern veteran requires the pilot to destroy a revanchist gunboat that has stalked their farm rig before they will hand over the key.
missions.private_fact: The gunboat crew is led by his own nephew, who considers any cooperation with the old enemy treason.

beats.public_change: The minefield reaches critical distance from the jump gate ring. Proximity alarms sound across {system}.

missions.reason: The warden needs the pilot to deliver both cryptographic modules to the central gate transmitter before the magnetic detonators lock onto the station.
missions.private_fact: Entering both keys will permanently upload both commanders' wartime service records to the public naval registry.

player_choice.prompt: The transmission console is ready. Activating the cipher defuses the minefield but exposes both veterans to war crimes prosecution.

options.label: Broadcast the full dual cipher and disarm the minefield
Scramble the identity headers before transmission, risking partial detonation
Refuse to broadcast and let the gate authority evacuate

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot broadcasts both keys in full, defusing the minefield completely.
resolutions.summary: The minefield stands down safely and the gate reopens, but military investigators immediately issue arrest warrants for both {role:covenant_veteran} and {role:loyalist_veteran}.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot disarmed a dormant border minefield, though it cost two retired commanders their freedom.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot scrubs the registry headers, protecting the veterans at the cost of imperfect disarmament.
resolutions.summary: Most mines deactivate, but a rogue pair detonates against the outer gate pylon. {role:gate_warden} faces repair delays, while both veterans escape into hiding.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot wiped identity records while disarming border mines, protecting old veterans from tribunal arrest.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot refuses to broadcast or never intervenes.
resolutions.summary: The drifting minefield impacts the gate ring, shattering the focal mirrors. {role:gate_warden} evacuates the hub, and the junction lane closes indefinitely.

loose_threads.detail: The telemetry signature from the minefield matches a secret naval ordnance contract that was officially audited and declared cancelled thirty years ago.
A clerk at the relay dock mentions that an anonymous charitable trust has been paying the port fees for both veterans' remote berths from the same account.

radio_hooks: Drifting cluster of wartime area-denial mines threatens commercial gate corridor in {system}.
Gate authorities appeal for demobilization armistice records to clear dormant ordnance.
Unregistered gunboats sighted harassing outer orbital stations near old border sector.

voice_direction.covenant_veteran: Speaks in harsh, measured monosyllables and refuses to use pleasantries. Never mentions his former rank.
voice_direction.loyalist_veteran: Soft-spoken, weary, and pauses as if expecting incoming fire. Changes the topic whenever his family is mentioned.
voice_direction.gate_warden: Fast, stressed, and snaps at radio operators between sentences. Never admits that her emergency evacuation tugs are uncrewed.
